Title: Ingestion of foreign bodies and caustic substances in children: a narrative review on clinical evaluation and management update
Abstract: Recent management strategies emphasize urgent <m>endoscopic</m> <m>removal</m> of high-risk foreign bodies such as esophageal <m>button</m> <m>batteries</m> and multiple high-power magnets; early endoscopy for <m>symptomatic</m> caustic <m>ingestions</m>; the avoidance of procedures during the high-risk tissue fragility window and the use of standardized clinical pathways to guide risk stratification, imaging, and timely intervention.
